```python
import narwhals as nw

# Sample DataFrame
data = {
    "name": ["Alice", "Bob", "Charlie", "Diana"],
    "spend": [1500, 800, 1000, 500]
}

df = nw.from_dict(data)

# Add tier column using conditional expression
df = df.with_columns(
    tier=nw.when(nw.col("spend") >= 1000).then(nw.lit("gold")).otherwise(nw.lit("standard"))
)

print(df)
```
